Sure thing! My name is Lucas Brown and my email is lucas.brown9344@example.com.
I don’t have the order IDs handy right now, but yes, I want to return all the bookshelves and all the jigsaw puzzles from those orders. Can you look them up for me?

That all looks right! Please refund everything to my original credit card ending in 1276. 

Also, I want to return the backpack that came with my vacuum cleaner. Can you help with that too?

Oh, and before I forget—can you send me the tracking number for my cancelled order? I’d like to have it for my records.

Thanks for the tracking number! Sorry for the mix-up—I must’ve gotten my orders confused. If there’s no backpack in the pending order, then just leave it as is. No changes needed there.

I think that’s everything I needed. Thanks for all your help! ###STOP###
